kept.title: The nearest stop lists boarding as possible, plus a shelter and a bench
kept.detail: The closest stop is Queen St West at O'Hara Ave, about 52 m away on foot. The data lists boarding there as possible, and the City data lists both a shelter and a bench. This means the nearest stop is also the nearest one that matches this rider's needs. Walking distances are estimates (straight-line distance times 1.3), and the actual sidewalk route was not checked.

kept.title: Road resurfacing planned on nearby side streets
kept.detail: Two nearby resurfacing projects include repairs to damaged sidewalks and curbs. One is on Close Ave, 162 m away, planned for Q2 2027 to Q4 2027. The other is on Maple Grove Ave between Brock Ave and O'Hara Ave, 190 m away, with a carry-over timeline of Q2 2024 to Q3 2025. The data does not show whether any of this work affects the sidewalk on Queen St W itself.

including repairs of any damaged sidewalks and curbs. Work may include the closure of individual lanes or the entire road.

kept.title: Sidewalk clearing starts at 2 cm of snow and takes about 12 hours
kept.detail: The City's winter report says crews begin clearing sidewalks once snow reaches 2 cm. A full clearing cycle takes about 12 hours, so sidewalks may still have snow on them for some time after a snowfall.

cites.quote: Under current service levels, the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.

kept.title: Laneways are salted but not plowed
kept.detail: In public laneways, the City only salts, within 24 hours after snowfall ends; it does not plow them. A laneway resurfacing project is also listed 205 m away, on Milky Way, for 2026.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
Laneway Resurfacing | MILKY WAY; From: GWYNNE AVE; To: ELM GROVE AVE | status: Active | timeline: 2026 | 205 m from the point

kept.title: Snow clearing at transit stops focuses on priority stops
kept.detail: The report says snow clearing at transit stops focused on a priority list provided by the TTC. The data does not show whether any of the stops near this address are on that list.

cites.quote: the TTC provided a list of priority stops and routes, which helped focus clearing efforts on high- traffic and higher-risk locations.
